eips.title: State Creation Gas Cost Increase
eips.summary: Two potential spec changes were debated: a self-destruct refill issue and a cross-frame gas laundering bug, with decisions deferred to ACDC.

moments.context: Maria raised that the EL breakout would discuss potential updates to EIP-8037, two of which require spec changes, and asked about impact on fork timings.
Pawel explained the self-destruct sandwich pattern where users are charged for creating a contract but do not get the state gas refill back under current EIP-8037 spec.
Maria explained the April decision to drop ephemeral deployment refills for simplicity and to avoid incentivizing continued self-destruct usage.
Discussion of the cross-frame gas refill bug where state gas freed in a child frame does not properly refill gas left in the parent, allowing gas laundering from execution gas to state gas.
Gary from Geth said the change is semantically correct but needs complexity evaluation and preferred deferring to ACDC.
Luis from Besu asked about security implications and whether this introduces new behavior versus existing pre-8037 behavior.

eips.title: Remove SELFDESTRUCT Burn
eips.summary: Pawel referenced it as the EIP that removed the self-destruct burn event, noting the refill logic could be placed in the same end-of-transaction location.

moments.context: Pawel mentioned EIP-8246, the one that removed the burn event, as the place where the self-destruct refill logic could be implemented.

eips.summary: Pawel referenced it as one of many EIPs that tries to incentivize transactions that do not increase state size.

moments.context: Pawel argued that the ephemeral contract pattern is compatible with the intent of state gas, noting EIP-8047 as one of many proposals trying to incentivize not increasing state.

eips.title: Resource-based intrinsic transaction gas
eips.summary: Guru cited it as an example where authorization set-and-clear in the same transaction already does not get a state gas refill.

moments.context: Guru noted that under the EIP-2780 spec, setting and clearing an authorization on a new account in the same transaction does not produce a refill, showing asymmetry already exists.

eips.title: Remove storage-clear refund and refund cap
eips.summary: Kevaundray asked in chat whether EIP-3298 (refund removal) was also planned for the next fork.

moments.context: Kevaundray asked in chat if EIP-3298 was included in the next fork, and Guru clarified it was about refund removal.

eips.title: Deprecate SELFDESTRUCT
eips.summary: Mario shared the EIP link noting it was the EIP that deprecated SELFDESTRUCT in Shanghai.

moments.context: Mario shared the link to EIP-6049 as the EIP that deprecated SELFDESTRUCT, in the context of discussing whether deprecation was done properly.
